text: 通智科技发布关于品茗科技相关公告事项的说明称，关注到品茗科技于11月3日发布的公告，本次中国证监会立案调查仅针对实际控制人莫绪军个人，不涉及品茗科技公司主体及现任董监高、经营管理团队，与上市公司经营及业务活动无关。通智科技将依托物理AI等人工智能底层技术，支持品茗科技提升核心竞争力，持续赋能品茗科技实现产业协同高质量发展。
text_en: Tongzhi Technology issued a statement on matters related to Pinming Technology's announcement, saying it noted Pinming Technology's announcement on November 3 that the CSRC's investigation is directed only at actual controller Mo Xujun personally and does not involve Pinming Technology itself, its current directors, supervisors and senior management, or its management team, and is unrelated to the listed company's operations and business activities. Tongzhi Technology will rely on underlying AI technologies such as physical AI to support Pinming Technology in enhancing its core competitiveness and continue to empower Pinming Technology to achieve high-quality development through industrial synergy.
